newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast light crudes weaken as WTI expires.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast light crudes weaken as WTI expires.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices fell Tuesday, weakening as traders rolled positions into the new month for West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude while Alaskan trade idled, traders said.
BP America offered at $1.25 a barrel under February WTI for February delivery, but buyers claimed they had ample inventories or would wait to see if March barrels were cheaper.
Buyers saw a 65-cent spread between the February futures contract, which expired today, and the March contract.
